props.name: value
props.description: Path data, controlled. Anything the parser understands; it is shown back normalised.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Path data to start from, uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with normalised, absolute path data after every edit.

props.description: Width of the drawing in its own units — the viewBox width.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the drawing in its own units.
